This creates a semantic alignment between models that supports robust downstream inference. Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) extends this by enabling dimensionality reduction without retraining, preserving semantic integrity. Semantic dilution introduces a constraint on input length, requiring mean pooling to maintain document-level coherence. Finally, trajectory accuracy metrics evaluate agent performance through DAG fidelity, integrating step efficiency and task completion into a unified framework. These primitives form a coherent system for scalable, interpretable, and adaptive language modeling.
